## Description
Provide a concise summary of the changes made and the problem they solve.

## Type of Change
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix
- [ ] `feat`: New feature
- [ ] `perf`: Performance improvement
- [ ] `refactor`: Code refactoring without behavior change
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation update
- [ ] `chore`: Tooling, dependency, or CI/CD change

## Verification Checklist
- [ ] Commit message(s) strictly follow the [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) convention
- [ ] `pnpm type-check` passes with no TypeScript errors
- [ ] `pnpm lint` passes with no lint violations
- [ ] Tested locally on an Android device or emulator
- [ ] Adheres to the **100% on-device, zero-cloud** privacy rule (no tracking, no telemetry, no remote uploads)
